While AI can now handle the technical minutiae of exposure, focus, and even basic news writing, your value lies in being physically present where algorithms cannot go. Your primary responsibility evolves into ethical gatekeeping—ensuring that in an era of deepfakes, your verified, human-captured content stands as a definitive record of history.
